title: audio
description: One audio_metrics message as worlds see it: emitted by the hub on Socket.IO namespace /viewer, event 'audio', once per valid audio_metrics received on /audio, and posted by the bridge to the world as { type: 'audio', audio } (or audio: null when stale, see CONTRACT.md). It is exactly the audio_metrics fields plus the hub 'timestamp'.

timestamp.description: Hub receipt time of the audio_metrics message, Unix epoch milliseconds (JS Date.now()). Consumers use it to judge staleness (frontend.audio_max_age_ms). The minimum rejects a value accidentally sent in seconds.
